title: Origin story: Sherlock Holmes
description: Sherlock Holmes of 221B Baker Street, consulting detective, practiced the science of deduction — observing the trifles others missed and reasoning backward from effect to cause. With Dr. Watson chronicling, he faced Moriarty at Reichenbach, kept bees in retirement, and became the most portrayed character in fiction.

title: Crossover notes: Sherlock Holmes
